newsitem.title: DUBAI: Irans says to produce locally built fighter plane.
newsitem.headline: Irans says to produce locally built fighter plane.

text.p: Iran said on Monday it would soon start mass-producing a fighter aircraft which it said had been locally designed and built.

State-run Tehran radio quoted a deputy head of Iran's Armed Forces Joint Chiefs of Staff as saying the aircraft was the result of efforts by Iranian air force experts and had been successfully tested.
"The production line of this aircraft will begin work in the near future," the military official, identified only as Brigadier-General Arasteh, said. He gave no further details.
Iran said in August its first locally designed helicopter, a six-seater, had passed flight tests at a state industrial development centre.
In October, Tehran said a Revolutionary Guards research centre had designed a four-seat helicopter.

Facing United States sanctions, and confronted with a Western arms embargo since the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war, Tehran has embarked on a strategy of developing military and civilian hardware which it cannot easily obtain from abroad.
The self-sufficiency efforts also aim to limit imports at a time when the country needs to save hard currency to pay back a large foreign debt.
